name: castle_in_the_sky
title: Castle in the Sky (film with angle blocks)

notes.text: The feature (VTS 2 PGC 1) has three 2-angle blocks: cells 1-2 (12 s each), 4-5 (99 s each) and 33-34. The PGC's PRE sets AGLN from g[14], so Play runs angle 2: cells 2, 3, 5, 6. Block-end junctions: 2 -> 3 at ~12 s and 5 -> 6 at ~331 s.
notes.why: A sanity check for the reader's angle-block playback when the cell-command hold applies in angle blocks (#176, dev-cellcmdhold13): no hitch at block ends.

notes.text: The rig's first menu is VTS 1 PGC 1, not the VMGM screen the model parks on, so a route never matched: the scenario Selects the default button on each menu instead (a film's default is Play).
notes.why: route_script waited at step 0 for the whole run (castle_h12).

notes.text: Power-on to the menu takes ~220 s (warnings and trailers), the feature starts ~50 s later; the 5 -> 6 junction comes ~330 s after that. capture_s 760.
notes.why: castle_h12b ended before the second junction.

angle_junctions.description: Play the feature from the menu through both early angle-block ends (2 -> 3, 5 -> 6): no frozen picture or silence of 1 s or more across either junction.
